summary: Tests-only phase: local HTTP stubs were added for manifest and recent-sheet reads, but the Swift toolchain is unavailable in this container and generated-client production code is deliberately out of scope for this phase.

references.result: The generator, runtime, and OpenAPI document are not present at this tests-only PR head.
Local-stub baselines cover manifest and recent sheets; generated operations and ranked results require the implementation phase.
Hand-written API DTOs remain until the implementation phase.
The tests use MockURLProtocol and no live server; execution was blocked because swift is not installed.
The required comparison baseline and the ranked-results response-schema gap are recorded; exact deltas require the imported upstream document.
